assumptions: (M,g) is a time-oriented globally hyperbolic Lorentzian spacetime
M admits a noncompact Cauchy surface Σ
R_ab k^a k^b ≥ 0 for every null vector k^a
M contains a closed future-trapped surface S
theorem.formal_output: ∃ future-directed null geodesic γ:[0,a)→M with a<∞ that is future-inextendible
nonclaims: does not define a local material point called the singularity
